## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- Compact flange outline: the figure shows the round flange O H with two flat sides W apart; drawn as the circle O H cut at x = +-W / 2, read from the figure, the corner and arc shape is not dimensioned (appearance, approximate)
- Angle of the two positioning holes on the round flange: drawn at 45 and 225 degrees on the pitch circle P (the figure shows them on the diagonal between the 4-d holes and marks 90 degrees without a dimension from the slit); the 4 mounting holes are drawn on the X and Y axes (appearance, approximate)
- Positioning holes Q: the diameter is a catalogue value; the H8 tolerance is printed as a class only and is not modelled, and the +-0.02 on the position (P / 2) is a tolerance of the pitch, not modelled
- Groove depth (S1 wide, position from L - B - S1) is not dimensioned: read from the figure as the cut from the top down to the bottom of the shaft bore; the radial slit is drawn over the ring length B only, from the shaft axis up through the outside on +Y (the stub below the bore is read from the figure) (appearance, approximate)
- Clamp screw side: the screw is drawn on +Y at height X with the clearance hole and counterbore on -X and the tapped hole on +X, read from the figure (appearance, approximate)
- Both flange types are built for every D of the table: the page prints one table for the round and the compact type and no per-type size restriction
- Surface treatment: black oxide film, electroless nickel plating (E-STHWRK) and none printed (stainless steel types) are recorded as printed and not modelled; the stainless types are also given a stainless accessory screw in the catalogue
- No chamfers or fillets, and the hex socket head cap screw supplied is not modelled
- Thickness (N): printed, and equal to (D1 - D) / 2 in every row; checked as the sleeve wall, not modelled as a separate feature
- The aluminium alloy long-sleeve flanged supports E-ATHWSBL / E-ATHWCBL printed in the upper half of the same page are not part of this generator
